name: ensoniqplaybig
description: ensoniqplay multi-bank streaming: an 88200-byte raw 8-bit PCM (4.0s at 22050 Hz) has a streaming pool > 64KB, so the mm_alloc pool spans multiple banks -- exercising the 24-bit cross-bank pool pointer (strm_copy LDAL + the far-store load) at a scale M2's sub-64KB tests never reached.  'finished after 2' (200-299 ticks; 88200/22050 = 4.0s = ~240 ticks) proves the whole file streamed across bank boundaries.
